properties.name: THIRD SIGHTING, third project (the flo2 design "ideal knowledge graph", reflow2 0.74.0): a check with 4 evidence parts, 3 measured and 1 blocked on an identity the agent could not hold, had to read `blocked` as a whole. It is the qs shape (blocked elsewhere), not the expected-change shape. The option of splitting the run (dec:idea-a-run-can-pass-with-its-exceptions-stated, option d) was unknown to the agent
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-09-29, triaging art:dev-reflow2-two-agent-exercise-feedback-2026-09-29, item I19.

① OBSERVED (designer's friction log #24): "No partial verification status. 3 of the 4 evidence parts were measured and 1 was blocked, so the whole check reads `blocked`." The parts: flo2 sessions (measured), the derived-to-asserted ratio (measured), reflow2's cold load (measured), and StoryFlow per-story counts (blocked: the stats routes need a real user's identity). NOT affected: wholly passing or wholly failing runs.

② PRECEDENT, searched in reflow2 and flo2: fact:defect-a-verification-cannot-record-a-partly-blocked-run (qs, 2026-09-04, the same shape); fact:root-cause-a-run-has-one-status-and-its-qualification-reaches-no-rollup-2026-09-28 (dev_storyflow, the expected-change shape, which walked this class); dec:idea-a-run-can-pass-with-its-exceptions-stated (the options, proposed). Nothing in flo2's design.

③ CANDIDATES: (a) the class already walked, with the status enum unchanged; (b) discoverability — option (d), split the run, needs no schema and was not reached; (c) the observation is wrong — the blocked part should never have been in the same check.

⑤ MEASURED on 0.74.0 (schema/verify.yaml): status enum [planned, passing, failing, skipped, blocked, superseded], unchanged. Nothing per part: VERIFIES.coverage and set_evidence_scope are SCOPE, not outcome, as measured on 09-28. The designer's log shows it never considered splitting. ⇒ (a) holds, (b) holds as a contributing path, and (c) is consistent with (b): four independently obtainable pieces of evidence were one check because they answered one owner request.

⑥ CLASS: unchanged, one machine-read outcome per run. What this sighting adds to the idea: a THIRD project and the SECOND "blocked elsewhere" case, so qs's n=1 is now n=2. And the blocking here was a permission boundary (an identity the agent must not assume), not a missing simulator.

⑦/⑧ OWED: nothing new beyond the 09-28 record. The idea stays the owner's call.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: whether the owner agent would have accepted four separate checks. It asked for the evidence as one list.
